messages:
anne: quick sync — postmortem follow-up for last week's vendor chain outage. created action tracker and assigned owners. see below.

raj: thanks. link?

anne: https://redwood.internal/trackers/INC-2026-487 :point_up: 

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-487 created by @anne — severity: P1; impacted: model-registry auth requests -> 2 regions; start: 2026-03-15T09:12Z; mitigated: 2026-03-15T10:03Z

carla: quick summary: cloud provider auth tokens expired earlier than expected, cascade to model-registry API creds, fallback to backup auth provider failed due to rate-limit config we never exercised.

michael: action items I captured:
- A1: Harden auth token refresh + proactive rotate window (owner: michael) due 2026-03-22
- A2: Add secondary model-registry read-only cache to serve on auth failures (owner: raj) due 2026-04-05
- A3: Add circuit breaker for external auth provider in runtime (owner: d.chen) due 2026-03-29

raj: added note — A2 needs infra estimate. I'll ping infra-alloc.

anne: we also need recurring drill for vendor failover. propose monthly 30-min tabletop + quarterly dry-run.

ops-lead: agree, ops will schedule first tabletop week of Apr. pinging @carla for runbook updates.

carla: runbook TODOs:
- verify TTL defaults in cloud KMS rotation doc
- add explicit rate-limit backoff guidance
- add decision tree: when to failover-model-registry -> fallback cache

raj: small config snippet for circuit breaker we should add to runtime config:
```
circuit_breaker:
  failures_before_open: 5
  open_duration_seconds: 120
  half_open_probe: 1
```

d.chen: I'll prototype and post perf numbers. If we add half_open_probe=1 we risk latency spikes during recovery. I'll run canary.

michael: for ownership mapping, let's put items into tracker with labels: owner, due, severity, effort, rollback. I'll take A1 now.

anne: note on recurrence: we saw similar auth token TTL drift twice in 12 months. Ops: can we add pager threshold if auth-failures spiking > 20% for 5m? @sre-bot can you add alert proposal?

sre-bot: Alert proposal: auth_provider_fail_rate > 20% for 5m -> PagerDuty escalation to oncall_auth (priority P2). Draft link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/123

carla: small test command to simulate fallback path:
```
# simulate auth failure and ensure cache serves
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer invalid" https://model-registry.internal/v1/models | jq .status
```

raj: noted. I'll run that in staging after change window.

anne: next check-in in 7 days. Please update tracker ASAP and comment when you complete owner's pre-checks. Thanks :thumbsup:

michael: done — created PR for token refresh window, assigned to sec-review.

d.chen: started canary run at 2026-03-16T15:40Z, posting numbers in tracker.

carla: updated runbook and added decision flowchart. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vendor-fallback

ops-lead: scheduled tabletop 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC. invite sent.

anne: closing loop — keep tagging this thread with progress updates. if blockers escalate, escalate to exec-ops.

michael: noted and will update tracker as tasks complete.
